member: Farah — Post-Harvest and Cooperative Operations Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Kofi, a full warm tonne cannot go in at once and stay cold using the stackable vented crates (C7), where food-grade means safe plastic for direct produce contact. Plain words, the chiller holds steady cold but cools warm produce very slowly, so load in small daily batches. Numbers are 50.0 h pull-down at 0.5 kW net per the pulldown hours for 25 kWh at 0.5 kW net (E53) against 150 W steady electric per the steady electric watts from COP 2.5 (E51), sane against one-third of a household day, so my routine limits warm intake to about one-fifth of the store per day.

The box still holds one tonne with a person inside using the two side racks with centre aisle (C8). Plain words, low side shelves leave a walkway with air gaps for cold air and mopping. Numbers are 600 by 400 mm crates per the plastic2go.com.au Best Folding Vented 600x400 Plastic Crates (E26), about 60 crates at 15 to 20 kg, stacked 3 high with 100 mm gaps and 900 mm door per the Interior plan and section (E36), sane against a bucket of water per lift and a household doorway.

Daily use stays clean using the washable hygienic routine (C9), where First-In-First-Out (FIFO) means oldest crates sold first. Plain words, smooth liners plus outside crate washing limit rot. Numbers are washable surfaces required per the faolex.fao.org mlt35655.max (E34). Not ready, because batch size with Lena and rack fixings with Kofi are still open.
